  "proposed_template": "# .github/workflows/monorepo-ci.yml — monorepo CI for module-organized
# projects (Dabbler). Scaffolded by the Dabbler AI Orchestration extension.
#
# The contract:
#
#   - THE AGGREGATE CHECK (active) — every PR and every merge to `main`
#     builds and tests EVERY module. This is the anti-integration-bomb
#     rule: cross-module breakage surfaces before the merge that would
#     cause it. This job is the required status check for branch protection.
#
#   - PATH-SCOPED JOBS (for large repos) — for faster feedback, large
#     repositories can add path-scoped jobs that run only when a module's

name: Monorepo CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test:
    # This is the required status check. It runs on every PR and merge to
    # main, testing all modules to prevent integration breakage.
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Build and test ALL modules

          if [ ! -d "services" ] || [ -z "$(find services -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
            echo "No modules found in 'services/'. Skipping tests."
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "ERROR: Modules found in 'services/', but the 'test' job is still a placeholder." >&2
          echo "Please adapt .github/workflows/monorepo-ci.yml to run your real tests." >&2
          exit 1
